item.description: The sync.map function's implementation doesn't properly handle the on_done callback execution. In the test_kwargs test, namespace.on_done is returning None instead of the expected value from the on_done callback. This happens because the on_done callback is not being invoked correctly with the proper parameters.
item.contract: The on_done callback in the sync module's map function must be called with the correct stage status and kwargs parameters when the worker finishes processing. The callback should be executed once per worker and should properly pass the return value of on_start to on_done.

item.description: The Stage.to_iterable method in the sync module does not correctly invoke the on_done callback with the proper parameters. The callback execution is not properly handling the kwargs passed from on_start and stage status information.
item.contract: The on_done callback in sync stages must be invoked with a StageStatus object and the kwargs returned by on_start. The callback execution should happen once at completion of processing and should handle potential exceptions gracefully.

item.description: The sync module's stage processing logic doesn't properly manage the worker lifecycle callbacks (on_start and on_done) for the single-worker scenario. The current implementation incorrectly handles the execution flow for these callbacks.
item.contract: The sync module's stage processing must correctly execute on_start once at the beginning and on_done once at the end of processing, passing the appropriate parameters including worker_info and stage_status objects.
